label: CCTC Detailed Content Outline (effective 2026-07-01)
source: ABTC Candidate Handbook (rev. 3/12/2026), CCTC Detailed Content Outline effective 7/1/2026.
_blueprint_note: Per the handbook, this outline is 'written to the domain level': domain item counts are binding (±2), task-level counts are recommended targets.
_cognitive_note: The 2026-07 outline does not publish a cognitive-level split. These targets are carried over from the prior outline (Recall 52 / Application 78 / Analysis 20 of 150) as best-available guidance. Treat as soft targets, not hard requirements.
_organ_note: The 2026-07 outline does not restate organ secondary specs for CCTC. Counts are carried over from the prior outline's secondary specifications (75 general / 75 organ-specific of 150) and the handbook's statement that ~50% of items are general. Soft targets.

tasks.name: Instruct candidate/support on risks, benefits, and alternatives of transplantation and living donation
Review indications and contraindications of transplantation and living donation
Inform the living donor about immediate post-op care and short/long-term complications
Inform donor/candidate about the evaluation and selection process
Inform candidate about post-operative care (drug regimen, complications)
Educate recipient and support system about infection and organ rejection
Educate living donor and support system about complications and expected follow-up
Review objective data and anticipate additional consultations
Compile multidisciplinary recommendations and facilitate testing/consults/protocols
Assess and present evaluation summary to determine suitability
Communicate the team's recommendations to candidate/living donor
List, maintain, and/or remove candidate from waitlist per OPTN policy
Present donor information and candidate's current condition to physician(s)
Coordinate pre-operative procedures for candidate, living donor, and facility
Identify abnormalities in exam findings, lab values, and diagnostic studies
Assess and understand post-transplant recipient complications
Summarize the potential risks/adverse effects of the drug regimen
Assess for long-term complications
Coordinate post-transplant care
Facilitate discharge medications
Direct recipient toward proper emergency evaluation and treatment
Facilitate required data to the OPTN/UNET
